text:
alex: deploy-bot paused the billing canary — Chart.lock shows subchart `currency` at 4.2.0 but we rolled expecting 4.3.0. canary id canary-billing-2026-03. anyone?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] CANARY PAUSED: artifact lock mismatch detected. requested: billing v4.5.0 + currency v4.3.0, deployed bundle contains currency v4.2.0. 5/60 pods failing readiness. Action: PAUSE_CANARY. logs: /deploy/logs/1801000000

jen: quick check: PR updated parent and subchart in description, but chart-publisher log shows a skipped publish step: "skipped: no artifacts changed" — likely CI race.

alex: choices: (1) manual pin canary to currency-4.2.0 (fast), (2) re-run chart-publisher to push currency-4.3.0 and promote (clean), (3) rollback. Ops preference?

ops-admin: prefer re-publish so artifacts match git. I'll approve chart-publish. Meanwhile you can pin to stop churn.

jen: applying temporary pin: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-billing-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart=currency-4.2.0 --overwrite`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin applied. Canary will not replace pods for pinned subchart.

jen: re-triggering publish now. ETA ~7m. adding release-note blurb about currency default rounding fix in 4.3.0.

jen: publish succeeded. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/charts/billing/4.5.0+sub-currency-4.3.0.tgz sha256: deadbeef1234 Promoted.

alex: removing pin and resuming canary: `kubectl annotate canary/canary-billing-2026-03 release.redwood/pin-subchart-; kubectl patch canary/canary-billing-2026-03 -p '{"spec":{"paused":false}}' --type=merge`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary resumed. Monitoring 30m. Initial health checks passing.

ops-admin: filing CI guard ticket to fail promotion when Chart.lock and PR disagree (ticket #2427).

alex: thanks all — adding artifact link to release PR and closing thread unless we see regressions.
